proofs.text: Run the build, cut the page at the inlined token block, and verify the block declares `--canvas` and that the text outside it contains zero hex colour literals

rule_text: Every colour the page uses is written inside the one inlined token block, and no colour literal appears anywhere else in the file

tests.body:
def test_every_colour_is_a_token(page_text):
    """The only place a colour is written is the inlined token block."""
    inside, outside = token_block(page_text)
    assert '--canvas' in inside
    written = [match for match in re.findall(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b', outside)
               if not match.lower().startswith('#purlin')]
    assert written == [], written
tests.name: test_every_colour_is_a_token
